text: The manager is in a meeting.
zh: 經理正在開會。
note: 無

text: Please call me back this afternoon.
zh: 請下午回電給我。
note: 無

text: I sent the file this morning.
zh: 我今天早上寄了那個檔案。
note: 無

text: The printer is broken again.
zh: 印表機又故障了。
note: 無

text: We can have lunch at noon.
zh: 我們可以中午吃午餐。
note: 無

text: The taxi will arrive in ten minutes.
zh: 計程車十分鐘後會到。
note: 無

text: My room is on the fifth floor.
zh: 我的房間在五樓。
note: 無

text: We need a table for six people.
zh: 我們需要一張六人桌。
note: 無

text: This shirt is a little small.
zh: 這件襯衫有點小。
note: 無

text: I need to open a bank account.
zh: 我需要開一個銀行帳戶。
note: 無

text: The package will arrive on Friday.
zh: 包裹星期五會送到。
note: 無

text: My flight leaves early tomorrow morning.
zh: 我的班機明天一早起飛。
note: 無

text: It looks like rain this evening.
zh: 今天傍晚看起來會下雨。
note: 無

text: I have a doctor's appointment today.
zh: 我今天跟醫生有約。
note: 無

text: The meeting room is already booked.
zh: 會議室已經被訂走了。
note: 無

text: I usually drink coffee in the morning.
zh: 我早上通常喝咖啡。
note: 無

text: The elevator is on the left.
zh: 電梯在左邊。
note: 無

text: Please park behind the office building.
zh: 請停在辦公大樓後面。
note: 無

text: She is on vacation until Monday.
zh: 她休假到星期一。
note: 無

text: Welcome to the marketing department.
zh: 歡迎來到行銷部門。
note: 無

text: We'll issue the refund within five business days.
zh: 我們會在五個工作天內辦理退款。
note: We'll 縮寫又短又輕，容易只聽到 we。

text: I'm afraid the shipment has been delayed again.
zh: 恐怕這批貨又延遲了。
note: has been 弱讀成一團，聽起來像 /əz bɪn/。

text: Could you forward that message to the sales team?
zh: 你可以把那則訊息轉給業務團隊嗎？
note: Could you 常黏成 /kʊdʒə/。

text: The client wants to reschedule our call for Thursday.
zh: 客戶想把我們的通話改到星期四。
note: wants to 會縮成 /wɑnsə/，t 音消失。

text: I've attached the updated budget for the project.
zh: 我已附上這個專案更新後的預算。
note: I've 的 v 很短，容易誤聽成 I。

text: We're running low on paper in the copy room.
zh: 影印室的紙快用完了。
note: running low on 三個字連成一串。

text: Let me check the schedule and get back to you.
zh: 讓我查一下行程再回覆你。
note: get back to 的 t 會被吞掉。

text: The training session has been moved to the main hall.
zh: 教育訓練改到大廳舉行。
note: has been moved 連在一起，兩個弱讀虛詞很容易漏。

text: She's been with the company for almost ten years.
zh: 她在這家公司待了將近十年。
note: She's been 擠成一個音節，for 弱讀成 /fər/。

text: Don't forget to sign the contract before you leave.
zh: 別忘了離開前簽合約。
note: Don't forget to 的兩個 t 幾乎聽不到。

text: The store usually closes early on public holidays.
zh: 這家店在國定假日通常提早打烊。
note: closes early 的 s 與母音相連。

text: I'll transfer you to the customer service department.
zh: 我幫你轉接到客服部門。
note: I'll 極短，聽起來幾乎和 I 一樣。

text: We should confirm the booking before the price goes up.
zh: 我們應該在漲價前確認訂位。
note: should 弱讀成 /ʃəd/，goes up 連音。

text: The interview has been scheduled for Monday afternoon.
zh: 面試安排在星期一下午。
note: scheduled for 連音，for 弱讀幾乎不見。

text: Can you drop the report off at the front desk?
zh: 你可以把報告放在櫃檯嗎？
note: drop...off 被拆開，off at 連成 /ɔfət/。

text: They haven't replied to my message since last Tuesday.
zh: 他們從上星期二起就沒回我的訊息。
note: haven't 的 t 被吞，replied to 連音。

text: The new software isn't compatible with our old system.
zh: 新軟體跟我們的舊系統不相容。
note: isn't compatible 連在一起，否定 n't 最容易漏聽。

text: I'd rather meet in person than talk on the phone.
zh: 我寧願當面談，而不是講電話。
note: I'd rather 黏成 /aɪdræðər/。

text: Our department is hiring several new interns this summer.
zh: 我們部門這個夏天要招幾位新的實習生。
note: department is 連音，is 弱讀成 /əz/。

text: The manager asked us to submit the report by Friday.
zh: 經理要我們在星期五前繳交報告。
note: asked us 連成 /æs.ktəs/。

text: I should've asked the supplier about the delivery date before signing the contract.
zh: 我簽約前應該先問供應商交貨日期的。
note: should've 唸成 /ʃʊdəv/，聽起來像 should of。

text: If you've finished the form, please hand it in at the front desk.
zh: 表格填好的話，請交到櫃檯。
note: hand it in 三字連成 /hæn.dɪ.tɪn/。

text: They'd already left the office by the time I got back from lunch.
zh: 我吃完午餐回來時，他們已經離開辦公室了。
note: They'd 的 d 幾乎不發音，by the time 整串弱讀。

text: Could you pick it up from the printer and bring it to my desk?
zh: 你可以去印表機那邊把它拿過來，放到我桌上嗎？
note: pick it up 連成 /pɪ.kɪ.dʌp/，and 弱讀成 /ən/。

text: We've been waiting for the shipment since the beginning of last month.
zh: 我們從上個月初就一直在等這批貨。
note: We've been 三個音節擠在一起，for 與 of 都弱讀。

text: The client would've walked away if we hadn't offered a bigger discount.
zh: 要不是我們給了更大的折扣，客戶早就走人了。
note: would've 與 hadn't 都弱化，hadn't offered 連成一串。

text: I'll have someone look into it and call you back by the end of the day.
zh: 我會找人查一下，今天下班前回電給你。
note: look into it 黏成一團，and 弱讀成 /n/。

text: She's supposed to hand in the sales figures before the meeting starts tomorrow.
zh: 她應該在明天會議開始前交出銷售數字。
note: supposed to 唸成 /səpoʊstə/，hand in 連音。

text: You should've told me a bit earlier that the flight had been moved to Sunday.
zh: 你應該早一點告訴我班機改到星期天了。
note: should've 與 had been 都弱讀，整段容易糊成一片。

text: I've asked the assistant to set it up before the guests arrive.
zh: 我已請助理在客人抵達前把設備架好。
note: set it up 連成 /sɛ.dɪ.dʌp/，t 變成閃音。

text: They'd like us to fill out the application form and send it back today.
zh: 他們希望我們填好申請表並在今天寄回。
note: They'd like 的 d 被吞，fill out the 連音。

text: We could've saved a lot of money if we'd booked the tickets sooner.
zh: 如果我們早點訂票，就可以省下很多錢。
note: could've 與 we'd 都極短，a lot of 連成 /ə.lɑ.də/。

text: The technician said he'd come by after lunch to check on the machine.
zh: 技師說他午餐後會過來檢查機器。
note: he'd 的 d 幾乎聽不見，check on 連音。

text: I've been meaning to bring it up at the staff meeting for weeks.
zh: 我好幾個星期以來一直想在員工會議上提出這件事。
note: bring it up at 一整串連音，for 弱讀成 /fər/。

text: If the package doesn't arrive by Friday, we'll have to send another one.
zh: 如果包裹星期五還沒到，我們就得再寄一個。
note: doesn't arrive 連音，have to 唸成 /hæftə/。

text: He must've forgotten to turn the air conditioner off before he left.
zh: 他離開前一定忘了把冷氣關掉。
note: must've 唸成 /mʌstəv/，conditioner off 連音。

text: We'd better check with the hotel before we confirm the entire itinerary.
zh: 我們最好先跟飯店確認，再敲定整個行程。
note: We'd better 黏成一團，check with 的 k 被吞。

text: The intern has already filled out most of the paperwork for the audit.
zh: 實習生已經填好大部分的稽核文件了。
note: filled out 連成 /fɪl.daʊt/，has 與 of 都弱讀。

text: I'd appreciate it if you could look it over and give me some feedback.
zh: 如果你能看一下並給我一些意見，我會很感激。
note: appreciate it 與 look it over 各自連成一串。

text: They've decided to put the launch off until the market settles down.
zh: 他們決定把上市延後，直到市場穩定下來。
note: They've 很短，launch off 連音，until 弱讀成 /əntɪl/。
